reply:
Police should prioritize clearing four critical corridors to reach trapped survivors and active fires:

1. **Waverly Place (2 segments verified blocked):** Highest priority. Blocks access to **I-B3301 (53 Waverly Pl)**, a collapsed building on fire with 4 trapped survivors (59 occupants). Deploy 6 officers from SFPD-CENTRAL (3.1 min) to clear the ambulance corridor to Chinese Hospital (2.3 min).
2. **Pine Street (3 verified blocked, 3 partial) & Leidesdorff Street (1 verified blocked):** Directly blocks ground access to **I-B4721 (75 Leidesdorff St, 812 occupants, people stranded on roof)** and **I-B4750 (348 Pine St, collapsed, 70 occupants)**. Send 5 officers from SFPD-CENTRAL (3.7 min).
3. **Battery Street (1 likely blocked, 6 partial):** Critical N-S corridor serving **I-B4902 (447 Battery St, 5 trapped)**, **I-B5057 (32 Battery St, 90 occupants)**, and **I-B4584 (6 trapped, route likely blocked)**. Send 5 officers from STAGE-EMB (2.8 min).
4. **Grant Avenue (1 verified blocked) & Clay Street (1 verified blocked):** Blocks fire engines reaching active collapse-fires at **I-B3670 (800 Grant)**, **I-B3617 (808 Grant)**, and **I-B3457 (805 Clay)**. Send 4 officers from SFPD-CENTRAL (3.3 min).
